review_evidence: This AFP hash-partition contains 460 primary Isabelle theories; 445 contain 18,218 theorem/definition/function/datatype/locale/class-family declarations under a broad structural scan.

The partition spans independent Archive of Formal Proofs entries across mathematics, algorithms, semantics, verification, and supporting formal libraries; the declaration-light tail includes import roots, notation/setup modules, generated-code interfaces, and formal documentation theories.

Direct inspection of declaration-light representatives including Isabelle_C/README.thy shows that low declaration counts do not identify disposable noise: these theories encode entry interfaces, formal-document context, or setup used by substantive developments, so no lossless shared exclusion selector was established.
summary: Retain AFP thys hash-partition a in full as substantive Isabelle formalization content.
